# Lint rules

`@kirana-style/eslint-plugin` runs under ESLint and Oxlint with identical results; its rules
read the compiler. `@kirana-style/biome-plugin` carries the rules that need no compiler as
Biome GritQL plugins. Under Biome, run `kirana-style check --format github --max-warnings 0`
in CI for what the compiler-backed rules would report.

Full page: https://kirana.style/docs/tooling/lint.md

| Rule | ESLint / Oxlint | Fix | Biome | What it reports |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kirana/diagnostics` | recommended (error) |  | no | Report the Kirana compiler's diagnostics. |
| `kirana/finite-bridge` | strict (warn) |  | no | Turn a bridged value that only takes a few literals into variants. |
| `kirana/no-class-helpers` | strict (error) |  | strict | Use cx, sx arrays and recipe() instead of class-string helpers. |
| `kirana/no-classname-on-sx` | recommended (error) |  | no | Do not pass className to a component that reads sx. |
| `kirana/no-conflicting-props` | recommended (error) |  | recommended | Do not combine className or style with a styleProps() spread. |
| `kirana/no-dark-variant` | recommended (warn) |  | recommended | Write dark mode as light-dark() tokens, not prefers-color-scheme conditions or dark: classes. |
| `kirana/no-unused` | recommended (warn) | suggestions | no | Report style handles and recipe variants nothing applies. |
| `kirana/override-keeps-conditions` | recommended (error) | suggestions | no | Override a component's conditional entries under their condition. |
| `kirana/prefer-token` | strict (warn) | suggestions | no | Use the token whose value a literal repeats. |
| `kirana/restricted-properties` | off |  | no | Report the properties, or the values of a property, the project rules out. |
| `kirana/sort-properties` | strict (error) | autofix | no | Order style properties and conditions canonically. |
| `kirana/sx-last` | recommended (error) | autofix | recommended | Put a forwarded sx last so callers can override. |
| `kirana/use-logical-properties` | off | suggestions | off | Use the logical property for a side of the inline axis, so a right-to-left page mirrors it. |

## Configure

```js
// eslint.config.js
import kirana from "@kirana-style/eslint-plugin"

export default [kirana.configs.recommended] // or kirana.configs.strict
```

```jsonc
// .oxlintrc.json
{
  "jsPlugins": [{ "name": "kirana", "specifier": "@kirana-style/eslint-plugin" }],
  "rules": { "kirana/diagnostics": "error", "kirana/sx-last": "error" }
}
```

```jsonc
// biome.json
{ "extends": ["@kirana-style/biome-plugin/recommended"] } // or /strict
```

```yaml
# CI under Biome: the compiler's own diagnostics, as pull-request annotations
- run: npx kirana-style check src --format github --max-warnings 0
```
